list.title: Permissions I've given
list.lead: Manage which clinic can see what, and until when.
list.emptyTitle: You haven't given any clinic permission yet
list.emptyBody: Use the clinic code from your clinic to share your pet's details.

revoke.title: Revoke permission
revoke.body: {{clinic}} will no longer see any details about {{pet}}. This takes effect immediately.

grant.title: Give a clinic permission
grant.lead: Choose which of your pet's details the clinic can see, and until when.
grant.codeHint: You can get the code from your clinic.
grant.noPets: To give permission, add a pet first.
grant.endsOn: The permission ends automatically at the end of {{date}}.
grant.maxNote: Permission can be given for up to 1 year.
grant.activeNotice: This clinic already has permission for {{pet}} until {{date}}. Saving updates it with the choices below.
grant.pastNotice: The permission this clinic had for {{pet}} is no longer valid. Saving gives it again.
